name: Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS) ESC1 template exploitation
topic: Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS) ESC1 template exploitation
description: Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS) ESC1 template exploitation -- a hard-tier active directory challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS) ESC1 template exploitation"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is a double layer: hex -> base64 -> XOR. Unwind both layers and recover the 4-byte XOR key.
